terminal_metrics.label: Terminal modeled token price
terminal_metrics.description: Final-step price emitted by the configured PriceFunction_LinearRegression component across Monte Carlo paths; a modeled outcome, not a market forecast.

terminal_metrics.label: Terminal fiat transaction volume
terminal_metrics.description: Final-step fiat-denominated transaction value replayed from the documented synthetic demand series (seed 20260817); it is identical across paths because the exogenous series is not an uncertain parameter.

terminal_metrics.label: Terminal holding time
terminal_metrics.description: Final-step holding time drawn by the configured HoldingTime_Stochastic component (lognorm) across Monte Carlo paths.

supply.detail: Constant supply of 1,000,000,000 DTLB is configured and held fixed across every path; the value is illustrative and uncalibrated, and no mint or burn is modeled.

emissions.detail: The selected constant-supply scenario emits no emissions schedule.

vesting_unlocks.detail: No vesting or unlock controller is configured in this scenario.

liquidity.detail: The scenario models no liquidity depth or pool state.

treasury.detail: No treasury component or treasury authority is configured.

governance.detail: The scenario models no governance process or authority.

staking_reward_source.detail: No staking pool, reward source, or staking yield is modeled.

fdv.detail: FDV is not emitted or declared by this scenario's artifact contract.

apy.detail: APY is not emitted and cannot be inferred from the published tables.

demand_series.detail: The replayed fiat volume series is generated from a documented logistic formula with recorded seed 20260817 (20 periods, illustrative $ per step); it is not observed data and carries no client or market lineage.

priors.detail: All three uncertain parameters are illustrative, uncalibrated, and declared independent; their triangular ranges bracket the library defaults of PriceFunction_LinearRegression and HoldingTime_Stochastic, not fitted data.

interpretation_boundary: Modeled outcome intervals (P10-P90) are cross-path spreads of simulated outcomes under illustrative, uncalibrated, independent priors and a synthetic demand series; they are not confidence intervals, not forecasts, and not investment, launch, legal, financial, or decision-grade advice. Estimator confidence intervals name their estimator, method, and level separately. Live token decisions require qualified review and evidence outside this demo.
